game.name: walker-lane-tactics-jiean-yin
game.note: All 88 authored files (and the .uid files) are byte-identical to the a5 blobs.

components.explanation: shaders/exposed_tint.gdshader, hand-written by Jiean: canvas_item, exposed_amount (hint_range 0-1, default 0.0) and exposed_color (source_color, #E0453A); line 7 mixes the sprite's COLOR.rgb toward the red by exposed_amount * 0.7, alpha untouched (B03). Seen in play (B04, B06) and at controlled values 0 / 0.5 / 1 / 2 in Jiean's captures (B07).

game/exposed_driver.gd (a node in game/main.tscn, process_priority 10) reads main.gd's state, planned_offset, paused and time_scale and rules.gd's cells and reach (in_range, Chebyshev 1-2); move_toward at 5 per second of game time, holding while paused (B05). game/piece.gd gives every sprite its own ShaderMaterial (lines 56-59) and set_exposed_amount(). Result: the capture's taps, pause, confirm and turn 4 (B06); the per-frame log has the enemy at 0.0 throughout.

shaders/linen_square.gdshader (Jiean): spatial; albedo_tex with source_color, roughness_tex as data, normal_tex with hint_normal, uv_scale, roughness_scale, normal_strength (B10). Two ShaderMaterials, materials/linen_light.tres (tint white, normal_strength 1.0) and linen_dark.tres (#9A7F55, 1.5), on two PlaneMesh tiles in diorama/asset_diorama.tscn (B08). The Hessian 380 textures and their .import files (Lossless, normal-map flag only on the normal maps, detect_3d off), credited in ATTRIBUTION.md. Results: one material vs one shader (B09), the interface sweep (B11).

shaders/hint_experiment.gdshader (Jiean): unshaded; grey_srgb (source_color, filter_nearest), grey_raw (filter_nearest), use_srgb picks which writes ALBEDO (B12). hint/hint_experiment.tscn (Linear tonemap, exposure 1.0) with materials/hint_srgb.tres and hint_raw.tres, both binding assets/textures/hint_experiment/hint_greys.png (64/128/192, written by tools/write_hint_greys.gd). Result: both quads 64/128/192 on Compatibility (B13).

shaders/standard_generated.gdshader: the editor's conversion of a StandardMaterial3D with albedo, normal and roughness textures, saved by Jiean, unused by the game. Lines 7 and 19 beside linen_square.gdshader:4 and :11 (B14): source_color in both; hint_roughness_normal vs hint_normal.

tests/test_exposed_tint.gd (agent): uniform list via get_shader_uniform_list(), defaults and source_color from the source text, real key presses, every frame checked (B15); tests/test_materials.gd (agent audit) with godot/MATERIALS.md; tests/normal_map_check.gd (course code) calibrated by tools/calibrate_normal_map_check.gd (B10's curl ratios); test_report.gd writes the JSON reports. The earlier suites (test_rules, test_audio_events, check_assets) give their baseline counts (B16). Results and the three mutations: B16.

debug/capture_exposed.tscn and .gd: a debug scene (not the game) that runs main.tscn in a real window; key C calls the course's capture() at exposed_amount 0, 0.5, 1, 2 and writes P1/P2 beside the predictions. Jiean's captures from it are B07.
project.godot: main scene res://game/main.tscn and the Compatibility renderer (line 25) that decides the hint experiment's result (B02, B13).

code_result_pairs.observation: Capture run-02 (tint), frames 46-455: two turns out of reach with the value at 0; on turn 3 Right plans (3,4), in the enemy's reach, and the archer turns red within 6 frames; Left drains it in 6 frames.

Capture run-02 (tint), frames 455-997: taps every 0.1 s turn around from the current value; P mid-fade holds it (PAUSED overlay); Enter confirms and it fades during PLAY_MOVES; turn 4 starts in reach and it rises at once. Per-frame log: enemy 0.0 in every frame.
Capture run-02 (diorama): the scene's own camera, then the harness camera; linen_dark normal_strength 1.5 -> 0 changes only the dark tile; the shared shader's ALBEDO x 0.5 (in memory) darkens both.

Capture run-02 (diorama), frames 225-930: light tile uv_scale 0.5 coarse / 8 fine; normal_strength 0 flat / 2 deep; roughness_scale 0 from the lamp's mirror angle: about 1.5 % darker, no highlight (measured).
Capture run-02 (hint) frame 60: both quads 64 / 128 / 192, read from the 4K frame, beside Jiean's prediction (A 64/128/192, B 137/188/225).
Recorded reports: 46/46 at 30, 60, 144 fps; 148/148; earlier suites 51/70/38; three mutations exit 1 (evidence/a5/mutations); the film's rerun on the a5 copy (capture/film-rerun.json).
